purpose: Development experiments; one seed and three final function tasks, not a statistical benchmark.
notes: Bootstrap and GEPA were repeated after the ProgramAdapter integration.
API bootstrap used supplied generic square/double API labels; final scoring still uses function tasks.
The API bootstrap run predates the exported file_suffixes field; its absent field defaults to [.py] on load.
Datasets and runtime prompts were adjusted during development. Optimizers do not receive the final testset.
